steps.comment: NORTH.md 7, the stretch goal. Two passes over the same scene: option 0 keeps the crate and changes nothing, option 1 lights it. Both run the spliced segment on its own rather than the whole finale - the crate lands two hundred commands into page 1's opening, and printing all of that first would cost ten minutes and re-test what finale_ending already covers.
The whole mechanism: the last page whose conditions hold wins, and the crate page is page index 1.
steps.label: and Grimspite is running the crate page, not the ordinary finale

steps.comment: -- pass one: draw your weapon, and the crate stays in the party's hands. The block is found by its label and not by the first code 102 on the page: the finale opens with a choice of its own, and slicing from that one runs the whole introduction and takes the wrong branch while reporting a pass.
steps.eval: (function () { const l = $dataMap.events[2].pages[1].list; const i = l.findIndex(c => c.code === 102 && c.parameters[0].includes('Set the crate down')); const j = l.findIndex((c, k) => k > i && c.code === 301); $gameMap._interpreter.setup(l.slice(i - 3, j), 2); })()

steps.label: drawing your weapon keeps the crate
and nothing was set down in front of the throne

steps.comment: -- the picture, on its own. Counting key presses to land a screenshot on the blast does not work: at headless speed a press fast-forwards the printing of a window rather than dismissing it, so the same seven presses land on a different window every run. Set up the tail of the scene instead, from the fade before the fuse to just short of the trope bump, and count frames - there is nothing to press in that stretch and 260 frames is always the same place. It stops before code 122 so this pass changes no state at all: the counters are asserted after the real one below.
steps.eval: (function () { const l = $dataMap.events[2].pages[1].list; const c = l.findIndex(x => x.code === 102 && x.parameters[0].includes('Set the crate down')); const i = l.findIndex((x, k) => k > c && x.code === 242); const j = l.findIndex((x, k) => k > i && x.code === 122); $gameMap._interpreter.setup(l.slice(i, j), 2); })()

steps.comment: -- pass two: set the crate down, for real.
steps.eval: (function () { const l = $dataMap.events[2].pages[1].list; const i = l.findIndex(c => c.code === 102 && c.parameters[0].includes('Set the crate down')); const j = l.findIndex((c, k) => k > i && c.code === 301); $gameMap._interpreter.setup(l.slice(i - 3, j), 2); })()

steps.label: ITEM 1 was set down in front of the throne
and there is no crate any more

steps.comment: And the moment the crate is gone the page stops winning, so a player who lights it and walks out and back in gets the ordinary finale.
steps.label: Grimspite is back on the ordinary finale
